items.name: Lander Autopilot
items.description: Call the lander to the rover anywhere on a planet (costs ship fuel each use).

items.name: Deep Surface Scanner
items.description: Adds to the rover's deposit-reveal distance on unscanned planets.

items.name: Ship's Galley
items.description: Real food. Crew morale settles at 70 instead of 60.

items.name: Recreation Deck
items.description: Long voyages wear on the crew only after 60 days from port instead of 30.
